title: Deep Learning for RF Device Fingerprinting in Cognitive Communication Networks

dataset.name: Not explicitly reported
dataset.type_source: Commercial off-the-shelf ZigBee devices operating in the 2.4 GHz band

classes.correspondence: Each ZigBee device represents one class

experiments.name: Lab experiment
experiments.connection: Devices hardwired to a power splitter connected directly to the signal and spectrum analyzer
experiments.noise: Simulated additive white Gaussian noise added in MATLAB

data_split.transmission_integrity: All 17 segments of a given transmission belonged to the same set

proposed_method.name: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
proposed_method.description: CNN trained using the time-domain complex baseband error signal

primary_performance.metric: Identification accuracy / overall correct identification rate
primary_performance.experimental_condition: 7 commercial 2.4 GHz ZigBee devices in the outdoor experiment
primary_performance.evaluation_setting: Test set from the outdoor experiment

dataset.statement: We demonstrate our technique on a collection of 7 Digi XBP24CZ7SITB003 ZigBee Pro devices operating in the 2.4 GHz band.

primary_performance.statement: We develop a framework for training a convolutional neural network using the time-domain complex baseband error signal and demonstrate 92.29% identification accuracy on a set of 7 2.4 GHz commercial ZigBee devices.
